limitations: Includes standing Main Building No. 1 and its entrance facades. The separately mapped No. 2, assembly, station, sculpture, artwork and raised public footbridges remain outside model geometry.
Native footprint, setbacks and documented 243.4 m rise determine scale. Window bay spacing, exact granite patterns, pilotis, rooftop mechanical fixtures and lighting details are reconstructed.

The site grade and foundation use Japan’s official DEM5A. The frozen global DEM independently shows rooftop and urban artifacts. Runtime snaps to its ordinary terrain provider. Plaza and entrance grades remain approximate.

gradeEvidence.source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan Fundamental Geospatial Data DEM5A
gradeEvidence.basis: The global DEM shows substantial spikes and anomalous negative returns across this dense urban block. The official bare-earth DEM5A is selected for the building foundation. Both native elevation fields are preserved and viewed independently.
